thread:
Maria: Heads-up — onboarding sample app demo failing on streaming parse after pausing the tab and resuming. Repro steps below.
Omar: repro steps?
Maria: Open quickstart demo, start stream, enable DevTools network throttle (Slow 3G), then background the tab for ~5s and bring it back. Client throws JSON.parse 'Unexpected token' and UI hangs.
Kevin: which SDK/version?
Maria: browser-sdk 0.9.12 from quickstart. Node sample-app (same repo) behaves differently — it recovers but the browser errors.
Lisa: can you paste the raw stream frames from the network tab?
Maria: snippets: ```data: {"id":"r1","type":"response","chunk":"{"text":"hello"}"}

:keepalive:

data: {"id":"r1","type":"response","chunk":""}
``` After resume those lines sometimes land concatenated which breaks the JSON reassembly.
Omar: sounds like keepalive/comment lines are merging with data frames on resume; our parser assumes clear CRLF boundaries.
Kevin: this matches a bug we saw where the browser ReadableStream delivers partial boundaries after a pause and the SSE parser's state machine misclassifies the following '

data' as payload continuation. Node's fetch impl is more forgiving.
Maria: workaround for the demo: server can send an explicit final delimiter for logical chunks, e.g. `data: [END]

` or send keepalive as a colon comment only (`:hb
`) so it doesn't appear as a data frame.
Lisa: I'll add a quicknote to the onboarding doc and a unit test in sample-apps to repro with throttled network.
ci-bot: Created issue devex/sample-apps#1234: "browser quickstart: streaming parse error after pause/resume (keepalive merge)"
Omar: For SDK fix, suggestion: on JSON.parse Unexpected token, attempt a reparse after small backoff and try to merge with previous buffer chunk before failing. Add logs so we can correlate network boundary anomalies.
Kevin: I'll open a PR to make the browser-parser tolerant: hold last partial frame for ~50ms and attempt reassembly on resume; also add a checksum header per chunk to detect misassembly.
Maria: That sounds good — saved demo for tomorrow, thanks. :thumbsup: 
Kevin: FWIW we should add an e2e that simulates DevTools throttling + tab background/foreground to catch regressions.
Lisa: noted, adding to test matrix.
Maria: tagging @devex for visibility.
Omar: ping when PR lands and we'll verify sample app flow.
